synopsis.synopsisDesc: Grants for public programming that increases access to the arts in underserved communities.
synopsis.eligibilityCriteria: For-profit organizations are not eligible to apply under this program element. Applicants must be U.S.-based organizations located in the United States and must not have received a similar award from the Endowment in the prior two years.
